namibia.d: Deadvlei from the Sossusvlei road (out and back, about 1.2 miles across sand, easy, May-Oct); Big Daddy Dune (walk-up summit, about 1 mile, steep, May-Oct); Sesriem Canyon (out and back, short, easy, May-Oct)
namibia.m: Fish River Canyon Hiking Trail (4 to 5 days, 53 miles, self-supported camping, strenuous trek, 1 May-15 Sep)
namibia.st: The 2026 Fish River Canyon season was delayed by flooding: the trail opened on 15 May after two postponements, and Namibia Wildlife Resorts announced a reopening on 17 July 2026, so it closed again in between. Hikers register at Hobas and check out at Ai-Ais; confirm status with Namibia Wildlife Resorts.

napa.d: Mount St. Helena (out and back, about 10 miles, steep, Oct-May); Bald Mountain in Sugarloaf Ridge State Park (loop, about 6 miles, steady, Oct-May); Bothe-Napa Valley State Park redwood trails (loop, about 4 miles, steady, year-round)

nepal.d: Sarangkot ridge above Pokhara (out and back, about 4 miles, steady, Oct-Nov and Mar-May); Nagarkot to Changu Narayan (point to point, about 6 miles, easy to steady, Oct-Nov and Mar-May)
nepal.m: Everest Base Camp (12 to 14 days, about 80 miles, tea houses, trek, Oct-Nov and Mar-May); Annapurna Circuit (13 to 20 days, about 100 miles, tea houses, trek, Oct-Nov and Mar-May); Ghorepani Poon Hill (4 to 5 days, tea houses, trek, Oct-Nov and Mar-May)

new-orleans.d: Couturie Forest in City Park (loop, about 1 mile, easy, year-round); Twin Canals Trail at Barataria Preserve (out and back, short, easy, year-round)
new-orleans.st: Most of Barataria Preserve (Jean Lafitte National Historical Park) has been closed since 2 Feb 2026 for a multi-year rebuild of hurricane-damaged boardwalks, expected to take about two years and be finished by 2028; only the Twin Canals Trail day-use area is open, and trails reopen in phases (NPS).

nicaragua.d: Volcan Maderas on Ometepe (guided walk-up with a muddy, rope-assisted crater descent, about 8 to 9 miles round trip, steep, Dec-Apr); Mombacho cloud forest loops (loop, about 1 to 3 miles, easy to steady, Dec-Apr); Cerro Negro (walk-up summit, about 2 miles, steady, Dec-Apr)

nice-riviera.d: Nietzsche Path from Eze-sur-Mer to Eze village (point to point, about 1.5 miles, steep, year-round); Cap Ferrat coastal path (loop, about 6 miles, easy, year-round); Cap d'Antibes coastal path (loop, about 3 miles, easy, year-round)

north-cascades.d: Cascade Pass (out and back, about 7 miles, steady, Jul-Sep); Sahale Arm (out and back, about 12 miles, strenuous, Jul-Sep); Maple Pass Loop (loop, about 7 miles, steady, Jul-Sep)
north-cascades.m: Copper Ridge Loop (3 to 4 days, about 35 miles, backcountry camps, trek, Aug-Sep)
north-cascades.st: An April 2026 report said State Route 20 (North Cascades Highway) was closed to vehicles and recreation from milepost 130 near Diablo Lake to milepost 156 at Porcupine Creek because of December 2025 flood damage and a March rockslide, with repairs expected to take several weeks once a contractor was chosen; no later update was found. The Cascade Pass trailhead is reached from the west side by the Cascade River Road.

north-island.d: Tongariro Alpine Crossing (point to point, about 12 miles, steep, Nov-Apr); Pouakai Crossing on Taranaki (point to point, about 12 miles, steady, Dec-Mar)
north-island.m: Tongariro Northern Circuit (3 to 4 days, 27 miles, Great Walk huts, trek, late Oct-Apr); Pouakai Circuit (2 to 3 days, about 16 miles, huts, trek, Dec-Mar)
north-island.st: The Mangatepopo Track on the Tongariro Northern Circuit was damaged by fires in late 2025; DOC said on 4 Sept 2026 it is on course to reopen in mid-December 2026, and the new Oturere Hut and campsite open for bookings from 18 Dec 2026. The Great Walks season runs 23 Oct 2026 to 30 Apr 2027 (DOC).

nova-scotia.d: Skyline Trail (loop, about 4.7 miles, easy to steady, Jun-Oct; parking needs a timed reservation); Franey Trail (loop, about 4.6 miles, steep, Jun-Oct)

nyc.d: Central Park Reservoir loop (loop, about 1.6 miles, easy, year-round); Inwood Hill Park forest trails (loop, about 2 to 3 miles, easy, year-round); Staten Island Greenbelt High Rock trails (loop, about 3 to 5 miles, easy, year-round)

oaxaca.d: Sierra Norte village-to-village day stages (point to point, about 3 to 9 miles, steady, Oct-Apr); Hierve el Agua petrified waterfalls (loop, short, easy, year-round)
oaxaca.m: Pueblos Mancomunados (2 to 4 days, over 60 miles of trails, community cabins, trek, Oct-Apr)

okinawa.d: Yonaha-dake (out and back, about 3 miles, steep and muddy, Nov-Apr); Hiji Falls trail (out and back, about 2 miles, steady, Nov-Apr)

olympic.d: Hoh Rain Forest Hall of Mosses (loop, about 0.8 miles, easy, year-round); Hurricane Hill (out and back, about 3.2 miles, steady, Jun-Oct); Rialto Beach to Hole-in-the-Wall (out and back, about 3 miles, easy, year-round, tide dependent)
olympic.m: High Divide and Seven Lakes Basin Loop (3 to 4 days, about 19 miles, backcountry camps, trek, Jul-Sep); Wilderness Coast (3 to 4 days, camping, tide dependent, trek, Jun-Sep)
olympic.st: NPS road conditions seen in May 2026: Hurricane Ridge Road open (weekday utility closures 11 May to 30 June) but Hurricane Hill Road closed, Obstruction Point Road closed since Nov 2025 (winter), Olympic Hot Springs Road closed to vehicles by a washout (open to walkers and bikes), and Staircase Road closed by impacts from the Bear Gulch Fire. A US 101 Hoh River Bridge closure is in progress; the Hoh Rain Forest stays reachable from Forks. Check nps.gov/olym for current status.

pakistan.d: Fairy Meadows hike to the Nanga Parbat viewpoint (out and back, about 7 miles from the Raikot jeep track, steady, Jun-Sep)
pakistan.m: K2 Base Camp by the Baltoro Glacier (about 3 weeks round trip from Skardu, camping, expedition trek, Jun-Aug)

palau.d: Ngardmau Waterfall (out and back, about 1 mile with many steps, easy to steady, year-round)

palawan.d: Mount Tapyas in Coron (out and back, 720 steps, easy, Jan-Apr); Taraw Cliff in El Nido (out and back, short scramble, steep, Jan-Apr)

panama.d: Sendero Los Quetzales (point to point, about 4 to 6 miles, steady, Dec-Apr); Volcan Baru (walk-up summit, long day or overnight, strenuous, Jan-Apr)
panama.st: MiAmbiente reported Sendero Los Quetzales temporarily closed after flood damage to the access route at Alto Chiquero (article date unclear, 2025 or 2026); access was restricted earlier after Hurricanes Eta and Iota. Length is given as 6.5 km by MiAmbiente and 9.6 km elsewhere. Check Volcan Baru park announcements or the Alto Chiquero ranger station.

pantanal.d: Guided lodge-area walks and raised lodge roads (guided, easy, Jul-Sep)

papua-new-guinea.d: Highland village walks and birding trails (guided, easy to steady, May-Sep)
papua-new-guinea.m: Kokoda Track (8 to 9 days, 60 miles, village camps, strenuous trek, May-Sep)

paris.d: Fontainebleau forest GR 11 loops (loop, about 4 to 8 miles, easy to steady, Mar-Nov); Gorges de Franchard (loop, about 3 miles, easy, Mar-Nov)

peru.d: Rainbow Mountain, Vinicunca (out and back, about 6 miles at up to 16,500 feet, steep, Apr-Oct); Sacred Valley Inca site ridge paths (point to point, easy to steady, Apr-Oct)
peru.m: Inca Trail (4 days, 26 miles, camping, trek, Mar-Dec; closed in February); Salkantay trek (5 to 6 days, about 46 miles, lodges or camping, trek, Apr-Oct)
peru.st: 2026 Machu Picchu entry rules for Inca Trail trekkers are described differently by operators: some say the trail permit no longer includes a citadel entry and a separate ticket is needed, others describe a same-day entry through Circuit 3-B. Verify with the Peruvian Ministry of Culture before booking.

peruvian-amazon.d: Guided Tambopata lodge walks (guided, easy, May-Oct)

piedmont.d: Barolo vineyard loops (loop, about 4 to 8 miles, easy, Apr-Oct); Gran Paradiso day hikes (out and back, steady to steep, Jul-Sep)
piedmont.m: Grande Traversata delle Alpi (55 stages end to end, sections of 3 to 7 days, village lodging, trek, Jun-Sep)

prague.d: Pravcicka Gate from Hrensko (loop, about 7 miles, steady, Apr-Oct); Divoka Sarka valley (loop, about 3 to 5 miles, easy, year-round)

provence.d: Calanque de Sugiton (out and back, about 3 miles, steady, year-round; capped and booked in summer); Calanque d'En-Vau (out and back, about 5 miles, steep, year-round); Luberon village loops (loop, about 4 to 8 miles, easy to steady, Mar-Nov)

puerto-rico.d: La Mina Trail to the falls in El Yunque (out and back, short, easy, year-round); El Yunque Peak Trail (out and back, steady, year-round)
puerto-rico.st: La Mina Trail and Falls were listed as closed in an August 2026 travel guide, although one aggregator says all major El Yunque trails reopened by May 2026 and the Forest Service alert page was last updated April 2025. Confirm on the El Yunque alerts page.

puglia.d: Foresta Umbra beech trails (loop, about 3 to 6 miles, easy to steady, Apr-Oct); Gargano coastal cliff paths near Vieste (out and back, steady, Apr-Oct)

punta-cana.d: El Limon waterfall near Samana (out and back, about 1.5 miles, steady, Dec-Apr)
punta-cana.m: Pico Duarte (3 to 4 days, about 28 miles round trip, mountain shelters, strenuous trek, Dec-Apr)
punta-cana.pm: Pico Duarte needs a park permit and a mandatory park guide, arranged through a licensed guide service (a January 2026 trip report had the permit issued at the trailhead).

quebec-city.d: Les Loups Trail in Jacques-Cartier (out and back, about 4 miles, steep, Jun-Oct); Mount Royal summit loop (loop, about 3 miles, easy, year-round)

queenstown.d: Ben Lomond from the gondola (out and back, long day, steep, Nov-Apr); Queenstown Hill (loop, about 3 miles, steady, year-round); Roys Peak near Wanaka (out and back, about 10 miles, steep, Nov-Apr)
queenstown.m: Routeburn Track (2 to 3 days, 20 miles, Great Walk huts, trek, Nov-Apr); Kepler Track (3 to 4 days, 37 miles, Great Walk huts, trek, Nov-Apr)
queenstown.st: Roys Peak is closed to hikers during the annual lambing, roughly 1 October to 10 November. The 2025 storm and avalanche damage delayed the Routeburn and Kepler alpine sections (DOC, Nov 2025); no 2026 closure notice was found.
